tasks_completed.rationale: Spec §5.13 D + Q3e local-only no-auth: bind defaults to 127.0.0.1, external bind requires --allow-external flag. Handler class is dynamically assembled to bind TripStore + project_dir as class-level attributes.

tasks_completed.description: POST /api/route handler with timeline agent_id hardcode + cache (scripts/lib/server/route.py)
tasks_completed.rationale: AC-M5.5 identity hardcode: any agent_id in the request body is IGNORED; TIMELINE_AGENT_ID='timeline' is set in env before subprocess invocation. Cache key is from_option_id:to_option_id:mode. Lock held only for cache-write step (codex Q2: lock released during network round-trip).
Debounce is client-side; server treats every call as authoritative. 409-soft is advisory (save still proceeds, last-writer-wins). Writes to day[slot_id] top-level per v2 schema.
No gaode calls. Aggregates from day.json, transportation.json, route_cache.json. req.day filters to single day. Lock released before serializing response.

Calls trip_contract.load_trip to assemble meta + days + transportation + route_cache into TripResponse shape per M2-contract §9. Import is lazy so unit tests on common.py do not require trip_contract.
Invokes M6 exporters as subprocesses with CLAUDE_AGENT_ID set to pdf-export or ical-export (not on gaode allowlist). Per-trip lock held around subprocess to prevent concurrent /save mid-export.
TripStore provides per-trip mutex registry (codex Q2 single-writer). atomic_write_json uses .tmp + fsync + os.replace per §5.13 D #3.

tasks_completed.rationale: Tests call handler functions directly (no HTTP port). Covers: AC-M5.5 agent_id force (route), cache hit/miss, 409-soft conflict, atomic write, null-cost unknown_count, missing trip 404. 22/22 PASS.
